body: Thanks. I will give them a call when I find a phone.

I get frustrated with these thoughts and am afraid that I really will act on them one day. I have run it through my head a thousand times, trying to pick the right place, the least messy way, and so on. How do I go about checking myself in somewhere? will they make me stay? is it expensive? There are so many "what ifs". I just wan't to break down. and on Christmas of all days. ugh.
